text:
- **Records workspaces and site versions:** Each worktree now gets its own records workspace, and the site shows every draft beside the published version. Renaming a design page or doc rewrites its links in a single commit.
- **Owner questions and replies:** Ask-tool questions now close on the site or in chat, and the first answer wins. Owner replies reach the asking session by push alone.
- **CI checks:** Pull requests now grade AGENTS.md in diff mode, and reruns give the same verdict. MacOS Go jobs run on a daily schedule instead of on every pull request.
- **Docs rendering:** The docs now typeset math with KaTeX and draw MDX diagrams. Doc links resolve by slug, and a new docs index lists the notes.
